title.en: Merkle tree of the rule files, part 4 of 4: rules_root and manifest
title.es: Árbol Merkle de los ficheros de reglas, parte 4 de 4: rules_root y manifiesto

alt.en: The node N03 (leaves 0 to 3) and leaf 4 are combined into the top hash rules_root = H(01 || N03 || leaf4). rules_root is stored in manifest.json, which is signed with Sigstore.
alt.es: El nodo N03 (hojas 0 a 3) y la hoja 4 se combinan en el hash superior rules_root = H(01 || N03 || leaf4). rules_root se guarda en manifest.json, que se firma con Sigstore.

legend.en: green: leaf (one rule file); amber: internal node; white with a thick border: rules_root; purple: signed manifest.
legend.es: verde: hoja (un fichero de reglas); ámbar: nodo interno; blanco con borde grueso: rules_root; morado: manifiesto firmado.
